name: @local/dsh-bench
description: Experimental: A Devices mode and tab for the devices you connect to your Mac: 44 tools for boards, phones, routers, servers, debug probes, instruments, cards and tags, a live device dashboard, and a list of the programs it can use. It keeps a card and a logbook for each device. Writes follow each device's card; the owner's Allow risky writes switch lifts the backup and source conditions. Off until you switch it on.
